import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

file_path = '/data/programme_monthly_spend.xlsx'
# Read raw sheet
raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Monthly Spend', header=None)
# Find header row
# Row 3 contains Programme Code etc
header_row = 3
subheader_row = 4
# Build proper columns
# columns: Programme Code, Programme, Lead State, Funding Partner, Apr 2025, May 2025, Jun 2025, Jul 2025, Aug 2025, Sep 2025, Six-month Total (INR)
cols = ['Programme Code','Programme','Lead State','Funding Partner','Apr 2025','May 2025','Jun 2025','Jul 2025','Aug 2025','Sep 2025','Six-month Total (INR)']
# data starts at row 5
data = raw.iloc[5:].copy()
# assign columns
data.columns = cols
# keep rows where Programme Code not null and not 'PORTFOLIO TOTAL'
data = data[data['Programme Code'].notna()]
data = data[~data['Programme Code'].astype(str).str.contains('TOTAL', na=False)]
# Convert numeric columns
num_cols = ['Apr 2025','May 2025','Jun 2025','Jul 2025','Aug 2025','Sep 2025','Six-month Total (INR)']
for col in num_cols:
    # replace '-' and '–' with NaN
    data[col] = data[col].replace(['-','–','—'], np.nan)
    data[col] = pd.to_numeric(data[col], errors='coerce')
# Fill blanks with 0? The note says '-' / '–' / blank means zero
data[num_cols] = data[num_cols].fillna(0)
# Compute sum from months to verify
data['Computed Total'] = data[['Apr 2025','May 2025','Jun 2025','Jul 2025','Aug 2025','Sep 2025']].sum(axis=1)
# Find max by Six-month Total
max_row = data.loc[data['Six-month Total (INR)'].idxmax()]
print(data[['Programme Code','Programme','Six-month Total (INR)','Computed Total']].to_string(index=False))
print("\nMax row:")
print(max_row[['Programme Code','Programme','Six-month Total (INR)','Computed Total']])
